caption: A rubber duck is squeezed under the bathwater and released, and it squirts water and puffs back to shape.

sa.check: A rubber duck is squeezed under bathwater.
The squeeze comes first, then the release, then the squirt and the puff back.

pc.expect: It flattens while squeezed and rounds out when released.
pc.fail: It stays flat; or does not deform; or shatters.

pc.expect: The jet comes out on the squeeze, and the refill and rounding come on the release.
pc.fail: It squirts while unsqueezed; or squirts only on release; or puffs back while still squeezed.

pc.expect: The jet arcs and falls back to the water, and the duck floats up.
pc.fail: The jet rises indefinitely; or the duck sinks; or the water is rigid.

pc.expect: The water comes from the duck's hole.
pc.fail: It comes from elsewhere; or there is no jet; or the jet comes before the squeeze.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: The duck's colour and the bath stay the same.
pc.fail: The duck changes colour; or the bath changes; or the bathroom rearranges.
